TEST Fst with merged phyloseq objects per population

Centroids of geographic distance

# all finches lat long data
my_points <- data.frame(longitude = sample_data(microb_fr_otu)$Xdec,
    latitude = sample_data(microb_fr_otu)$Ydec,
    Island_Mainland = sample_data(microb_fr_otu)$Species_Label,
    row.names = sample_names(microb_fr_otu))
str(my_points)
## 'data.frame':    209 obs. of  3 variables:
##  $ longitude      : num  -25.3 -25.3 -25.3 -25.3 -25.3 ...
##  $ latitude       : num  37.8 37.8 37.8 37.8 37.8 ...
##  $ Island_Mainland: chr  "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" ...
table(my_points$Island_Mainland)
## 
##    El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa        Flores_F_moreletti   Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri 
##                        18                        21                        26 
##  Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis       La_Palma_F_c_palmae 
##                        18                        23                        15 
##      Madeira_F_maderensis        Mainland_F_coelebs    Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti 
##                        17                        21                        25 
##  Tenerife_F_c_canariensis         Tenerife_F_teydea 
##                        16                         9
df_sf <- st_as_sf(my_points, coords = c("longitude",
    "latitude"))

# get centroids per island / mainland
centroids_sf <- df_sf %>%
    group_by(Island_Mainland) %>%
    summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
    st_centroid %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,
        1], lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2])
str(centroids_sf)
## sf [11 × 4] (S3: sf/tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
##  $ Island_Mainland: chr [1:11] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki" ...
##  $ geometry       :sfc_POINT of length 11; first list element:  'XY' num [1:2] -18 27.7
##  $ lon            : num [1:11] -18 -31.2 -15.6 -15.6 -17.2 ...
##  $ lat            : num [1:11] 27.7 39.4 28.1 27.9 28.1 ...
##  - attr(*, "sf_column")= chr "geometry"
##  - attr(*, "agr")= Factor w/ 3 levels "constant","aggregate",..: NA NA NA
##   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3] "Island_Mainland" "lon" "lat"
rownames(centroids_sf) <- centroids_sf$Island_Mainland

# dist
dist_mat <- distm(cbind(centroids_sf$lon, centroids_sf$lat),
    fun = distGeo)  # Vector of distances in meters
dist_mat <- dist_mat/1000  #Vector of distances in km
rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(centroids_sf)
colnames(dist_mat) <- rownames(centroids_sf)
geo_dist <- as.dist(dist_mat)
str(dist_mat)
##  num [1:11, 1:11] 0 1779 240 234 87 ...
##  - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
##   ..$ : chr [1:11] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki" ...
##   ..$ : chr [1:11] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki" ...
# chaffinch subset
my_points_subset <- my_points %>%
    filter(Island_Mainland != "Tenerife_F_teydea" &
        Island_Mainland != "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki")
table(my_points_subset$Island_Mainland)
## 
##    El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa        Flores_F_moreletti   Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri 
##                        18                        21                        26 
## La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis       La_Palma_F_c_palmae      Madeira_F_maderensis 
##                        23                        15                        17 
##        Mainland_F_coelebs    Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti  Tenerife_F_c_canariensis 
##                        21                        25                        16
df_sf <- st_as_sf(my_points_subset, coords = c("longitude",
    "latitude"))

# get centroids per island / mainland
centroids_sf <- df_sf %>%
    group_by(Island_Mainland) %>%
    summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
    st_centroid %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,
        1], lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2])
str(centroids_sf)
## sf [9 × 4] (S3: sf/tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
##  $ Island_Mainland: chr [1:9] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis" ...
##  $ geometry       :sfc_POINT of length 9; first list element:  'XY' num [1:2] -18 27.7
##  $ lon            : num [1:9] -18 -31.2 -15.6 -17.2 -17.9 ...
##  $ lat            : num [1:9] 27.7 39.4 28.1 28.1 28.7 ...
##  - attr(*, "sf_column")= chr "geometry"
##  - attr(*, "agr")= Factor w/ 3 levels "constant","aggregate",..: NA NA NA
##   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3] "Island_Mainland" "lon" "lat"
rownames(centroids_sf) <- centroids_sf$Island_Mainland

# dist
dist_mat_chaff <- distm(cbind(centroids_sf$lon,
    centroids_sf$lat), fun = distGeo)  # Vector of distances in meters
dist_mat_chaff <- dist_mat_chaff/1000  #Vector of distances in km
rownames(dist_mat_chaff) <- rownames(centroids_sf)
colnames(dist_mat_chaff) <- rownames(centroids_sf)
geo_dist_chaff <- as.dist(dist_mat_chaff)
str(dist_mat_chaff)
##  num [1:9, 1:9] 0 1779 240 87 110 ...
##  - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
##   ..$ : chr [1:9] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis" ...
##   ..$ : chr [1:9] "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa" "Flores_F_moreletti" "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri" "La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis" ...

# dev.off()

subsample microbiome equal sample size

set.seed(24)
sample_ps <- function(ps, FUN = sample, ...) {
    ids <- sample_names(ps)
    sampled_ids <- FUN(ids, ...)
    ps <- prune_samples(sampled_ids, ps)
    return(ps)
}

levels(factor(sample_data(microb_fr_otu)$Species_Label))

Mantel tests

Mantel Bray-Curtis

(mantel_bray_fst_otu <- vegan::mantel(bray_dist_otu,
    fst_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 9999))
## 
## Mantel statistic based on Pearson's product-moment correlation 
## 
## Call:
## vegan::mantel(xdis = bray_dist_otu, ydis = fst_dist, method = "pearson",      permutations = 9999) 
## 
## Mantel statistic r: 0.3938 
##       Significance: 0.0093 
## 
## Upper quantiles of permutations (null model):
##   90%   95% 97.5%   99% 
## 0.234 0.288 0.333 0.390 
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 9999
str(mantel_bray_fst_otu)
## List of 7
##  $ call        : language vegan::mantel(xdis = bray_dist_otu, ydis = fst_dist, method = "pearson",      permutations = 9999)
##  $ method      : chr "Pearson's product-moment correlation"
##  $ statistic   : num 0.394
##  $ signif      : num 0.0093
##  $ perm        : num [1:9999] -0.1454 0.1598 -0.0331 0.1159 0.0524 ...
##  $ permutations: int 9999
##  $ control     :List of 12
##   ..$ within     :List of 6
##   .. ..$ type    : chr "free"
##   .. ..$ constant: logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ mirror  : logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ ncol    : NULL
##   .. ..$ nrow    : NULL
##   .. ..$ call    : language Within()
##   .. ..- attr(*, "class")= chr "Within"
##   ..$ plots      :List of 7
##   .. ..$ strata    : NULL
##   .. ..$ type      : chr "none"
##   .. ..$ mirror    : logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ ncol      : NULL
##   .. ..$ nrow      : NULL
##   .. ..$ plots.name: chr "NULL"
##   .. ..$ call      : language Plots()
##   .. ..- attr(*, "class")= chr "Plots"
##   ..$ blocks     : NULL
##   ..$ nperm      : num 9999
##   ..$ complete   : logi FALSE
##   ..$ maxperm    : num 9999
##   ..$ minperm    : num 5040
##   ..$ all.perms  : NULL
##   ..$ make       : logi TRUE
##   ..$ observed   : logi FALSE
##   ..$ blocks.name: chr "NULL"
##   ..$ call       : language how(nperm = 9999)
##   ..- attr(*, "class")= chr "how"
##  - attr(*, "class")= chr "mantel"
df_otu <- data.frame(test = "mantel", data = "all",
    taxonomy = "OTU99", dist = "Bray-Curtis",
    r = mantel_bray_fst_otu$statistic, p = mantel_bray_fst_otu$signif)



(mantel_bray_fst_otu_chaff <- vegan::mantel(bray_dist_otu_chaff,
    fst_dist_chaff, method = "pearson", permutations = 9999))
## 
## Mantel statistic based on Pearson's product-moment correlation 
## 
## Call:
## vegan::mantel(xdis = bray_dist_otu_chaff, ydis = fst_dist_chaff,      method = "pearson", permutations = 9999) 
## 
## Mantel statistic r: 0.3521 
##       Significance: 0.0256 
## 
## Upper quantiles of permutations (null model):
##   90%   95% 97.5%   99% 
## 0.220 0.291 0.354 0.446 
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 9999

# mat_edit <- read.csv(paste0(dataDir,

(p1 <- ggplot(mat, aes(y = bray, x = fst)) + geom_point(size = 5,
    alpha = 0.2) + labs(x = "Fst", y = "Beta diversity (Bray distance)") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "red",
        alpha = 0.2, lwd = 3) + theme_classic(base_size = 31) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,
            colour = "black"), plot.margin = grid::unit(c(5,
            5, 5, 5), "mm")) + ggtitle(""))

    fst_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 9999))
## 
## Mantel statistic based on Pearson's product-moment correlation 
## 
## Call:
## vegan::mantel(xdis = jaccard_dist_otu, ydis = fst_dist, method = "pearson",      permutations = 9999) 
## 
## Mantel statistic r: 0.04761 
##       Significance: 0.3886 
## 
## Upper quantiles of permutations (null model):
##   90%   95% 97.5%   99% 
## 0.267 0.344 0.420 0.544 
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 9999
str(mantel_jaccard_fst_otu)
## List of 7
##  $ call        : language vegan::mantel(xdis = jaccard_dist_otu, ydis = fst_dist, method = "pearson",      permutations = 9999)
##  $ method      : chr "Pearson's product-moment correlation"
##  $ statistic   : num 0.0476
##  $ signif      : num 0.389
##  $ perm        : num [1:9999] 0.1865 -0.19 0.0902 -0.0998 -0.1096 ...
##  $ permutations: int 9999
##  $ control     :List of 12
##   ..$ within     :List of 6
##   .. ..$ type    : chr "free"
##   .. ..$ constant: logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ mirror  : logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ ncol    : NULL
##   .. ..$ nrow    : NULL
##   .. ..$ call    : language Within()
##   .. ..- attr(*, "class")= chr "Within"
##   ..$ plots      :List of 7
##   .. ..$ strata    : NULL
##   .. ..$ type      : chr "none"
##   .. ..$ mirror    : logi FALSE
##   .. ..$ ncol      : NULL
##   .. ..$ nrow      : NULL
##   .. ..$ plots.name: chr "NULL"
##   .. ..$ call      : language Plots()
##   .. ..- attr(*, "class")= chr "Plots"
##   ..$ blocks     : NULL
##   ..$ nperm      : num 9999
##   ..$ complete   : logi FALSE
##   ..$ maxperm    : num 9999
##   ..$ minperm    : num 5040
##   ..$ all.perms  : NULL
##   ..$ make       : logi TRUE
##   ..$ observed   : logi FALSE
##   ..$ blocks.name: chr "NULL"

## ============================================================
## SENSITIVITY: resampling distribution of
## Mantel r and p
## ============================================================
## The Fst Mantel analysis above subsamples
## 9 individuals per population. Each draw
## yields slightly different
## population-level dissimilarities and
## therefore different Mantel r / p. Here we
## repeat the full pipeline N times to
## characterise that uncertainty.

# --- helper: subsample, merge per
# population, return pop-level distances ---
make_pop_dists <- function(ps_level, n_per_pop = 9) {

    ElHierro <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Flores <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Flores_F_moreletti"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    GranCanaria <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Polatzeki <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    LaGomera <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    LaPalma <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "La_Palma_F_c_palmae"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Madeira <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Madeira_F_maderensis"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Mainland <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Mainland_F_coelebs"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    SaoMiguel <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Tenerife <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Tenerife_F_c_canariensis"),
        size = n_per_pop)
    Teydea <- sample_ps(subset_samples(ps_level,
        Species_Label == "Tenerife_F_teydea"),
        size = n_per_pop)

    ps_sub_all <- merge_phyloseq(ElHierro, Flores,
        GranCanaria, Polatzeki, LaGomera, LaPalma,
        Madeira, Mainland, SaoMiguel, Tenerife,
        Teydea) %>%
        removeZeros()
    ps_sub_chaff <- merge_phyloseq(ElHierro, Flores,
        GranCanaria, LaGomera, LaPalma, Madeira,
        Mainland, SaoMiguel, Tenerife) %>%
        removeZeros()

    ps_merged_all <- phyloseq::merge_samples(ps_sub_all,
        "Species_Label", fun = sum)
    ps_merged_chaff <- phyloseq::merge_samples(ps_sub_chaff,
        "Species_Label", fun = sum)

    otu_all <- otu_table(ps_merged_all)[rownames(dist_mat),
        ]
    otu_chaff <- otu_table(ps_merged_chaff)[rownames(dist_mat_chaff),
        ]

    list(bray_all = vegdist(otu_all, method = "bray"),
        jacc_all = vegdist(otu_all, method = "jaccard",
            binary = TRUE), bray_chaff = vegdist(otu_chaff,
            method = "bray"), jacc_chaff = vegdist(otu_chaff,
            method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE))
}

# --- helper: run mantel + partial mantel on
# one (taxonomy, distance) combo ---
run_mantel_set <- function(d_all, d_chaff, dist_label,
    taxonomy_label, perms = 999) {

    m_all <- vegan::mantel(d_all, fst_dist, method = "pearson",
        permutations = perms)
    m_chaff <- vegan::mantel(d_chaff, fst_dist_chaff,
        method = "pearson", permutations = perms)
    pm_all <- vegan::mantel.partial(d_all, fst_dist,
        as.dist(log10(geo_dist + 1)), method = "pearson",
        permutations = perms)
    pm_chaff <- vegan::mantel.partial(d_chaff,
        fst_dist_chaff, as.dist(log10(geo_dist_chaff +
            1)), method = "pearson", permutations = perms)

    data.frame(test = c("mantel", "mantel", "partial-mantel",
        "partial-mantel"), data = c("all", "chaffinch",
        "all", "chaffinch"), taxonomy = taxonomy_label,
        dist = dist_label, r = c(m_all$statistic,
            m_chaff$statistic, pm_all$statistic,
            pm_chaff$statistic), p = c(m_all$signif,
            m_chaff$signif, pm_all$signif, pm_chaff$signif))
}

# --- one full iteration across all 7 levels
# x 2 subsets x 2 distances x 2 tests ---
one_iteration <- function(iter, perms = 999) {

    d_otu <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_otu)
    d_species <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_species)
    d_genus <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_genus)
    d_family <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_family)
    d_order <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_order)
    d_class <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_class)
    d_phylum <- make_pop_dists(microb_fr_phylum)

    out <- rbind(run_mantel_set(d_otu$bray_all,
        d_otu$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "OTU99",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_otu$jacc_all,
        d_otu$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "OTU99",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_species$bray_all,
        d_species$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Species",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_species$jacc_all,
        d_species$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Species",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_genus$bray_all,
        d_genus$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Genus",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_genus$jacc_all,
        d_genus$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Genus",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_family$bray_all,
        d_family$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Family",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_family$jacc_all,
        d_family$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Family",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_order$bray_all,
        d_order$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Order",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_order$jacc_all,
        d_order$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Order",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_class$bray_all,
        d_class$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Class",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_class$jacc_all,
        d_class$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Class",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_phylum$bray_all,
        d_phylum$bray_chaff, "Bray-Curtis", "Phylum",
        perms), run_mantel_set(d_phylum$jacc_all,
        d_phylum$jacc_chaff, "Jaccard", "Phylum",
        perms))
    out$iter <- iter
    out
}

# --- run N iterations ---
N_ITER <- 1000

# Sequential (simple, ~1-2 h on a single
# core depending on hardware):
set.seed(42)
mantel_resampled <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(N_ITER),
    one_iteration))

# Parallel alternative (much faster on
# Linux): library(future.apply)
# plan(multisession, workers = 8) # set to
# your core count mantel_resampled <-
# do.call(rbind,
# future_lapply(seq_len(N_ITER),
# one_iteration, future.seed = 42))

# --- summarise across draws ---
mantel_summary <- mantel_resampled %>%
    group_by(test, data, taxonomy, dist) %>%
    summarise(r_median = median(r), r_lo = quantile(r,
        0.025), r_hi = quantile(r, 0.975), p_median = median(p),
        prop_sig = mean(p < 0.05), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(mantel_resampled, paste0(dataDir, "/mantel_resampled_iterations.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mantel_summary, paste0(dataDir, "/mantel_resampled_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)
mantel_resampled$order <- factor(mantel_resampled$taxonomy,
    levels = c("OTU99", "Species", "Genus", "Family",
        "Order", "Class", "Phylum"))

p_resample <- mantel_resampled %>%
    filter(test == "partial-mantel") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = order, y = r, fill = data)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
        colour = "grey50") + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7) + facet_wrap(~dist) + labs(x = "",
    y = expression("Partial Mantel" ~ italic(r) ~
        "(F"[ST] * " | geo)")) + barplot_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35,
        hjust = 1, size = 28))

ggsave(paste0(outputDir, "/Figures/Fst_mantel_resampling.png"),
    p_resample, width = 360, height = 220, units = "mm",
    dpi = 200)

microbiome distance matrix

## OTU Bray
microb_otu_tab <- otu_table(microb_overlap_otu)
bray_dist_ind_otu <- vegdist(microb_otu_tab, method = "bray")
str(bray_dist_ind_otu)
##  'dist' Named num [1:5253] 0.883 0.994 0.993 0.997 0.994 ...
##  - attr(*, "maxdist")= num 1
##  - attr(*, "Size")= int 103
##  - attr(*, "Labels")= chr [1:103] "101_Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "105_Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "106_Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti" "117_La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis" ...
##  - attr(*, "Diag")= logi FALSE
##  - attr(*, "Upper")= logi FALSE
##  - attr(*, "method")= chr "bray"
##  - attr(*, "call")= language vegdist(x = microb_otu_tab, method = "bray")
bray_divergence_otu <- betadisper(bray_dist_ind_otu,
    microb_overlap_meta$Species_Label, type = "median")$distance %>%
    data.frame %>%
    rownames_to_column("TipID_microbiome")
names(bray_divergence_otu)[2] <- "b.beta_median"

# Mantel r
str(mantel_out)
## 'data.frame':    56 obs. of  6 variables:
##  $ test    : chr  "mantel" "mantel" "partial-mantel" "partial-mantel" ...
##  $ data    : chr  "all" "chaffinch" "all" "chaffinch" ...
##  $ taxonomy: chr  "OTU99" "OTU99" "OTU99" "OTU99" ...
##  $ dist    : chr  "Bray-Curtis" "Bray-Curtis" "Bray-Curtis" "Bray-Curtis" ...
##  $ r       : num  0.394 0.394 0.411 0.34 0.127 ...
##  $ p       : num  0.0093 0.0093 0.0123 0.0492 0.1816 ...
mantel_out$signif <- ifelse(mantel_out$p < 0.05 &
    mantel_out$p > 0.005, "< 0.05", ifelse(mantel_out$p <
    0.005 & mantel_out$p > 5e-04, "< 0.005", ifelse(mantel_out$p <
    5e-04, "< 0.0005", "n.s")))
table(mantel_out$signif)
## 
## < 0.005  < 0.05     n.s 
##       1       9      46
check <- mantel_out %>%
    filter(p < 0.05)

mantel_out$order <- factor(mantel_out$taxonomy,
    levels = c("OTU99", "Species", "Genus", "Family",
        "Order", "Class", "Phylum"))

## [49] "E"                    "VarE"                 "TipID_microbiome"
# Use FROH as the inbreeding coefficient
# (named `f` here for downstream consistency
# with the ANCOM-BC formula below; this is
# FROH, not the heterozygosity-based F from
# ind_het_meta).
froh_meta$Lab_Code <- as.character(froh_meta$"16S_Lab_Code")

f_df <- data.frame(Lab_Code = froh_meta$Lab_Code,
    f = as.numeric(froh_meta$froh)) %>%
    drop_na()

# Build the per-sample f table aligned to
# phyloseq sample order.  merge() does not
# guarantee row order, so we re-order
# explicitly and assert alignment before
# pushing values into sample_data().
Sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("rowid") %>%
    left_join(f_df, by = "Lab_Code")

Sample_df <- Sample_df[match(sample_names(microb_overlap_otu),
    Sample_df$rowid), ]

stopifnot(all(Sample_df$rowid == sample_names(microb_overlap_otu)))

sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_species)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_genus)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_family)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_order)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_class)$f <- Sample_df$f
sample_data(microb_overlap_phylum)$f <- Sample_df$f
